title: Linear Book Scanner
summary: Google engineer Dany Qumsiyeh presents a prototype automatic, non-destructive book scanner that turns pages and captures high-resolution images, built in Google's workshops. The talk includes a live demo and a short technical overview.
why: HN cites it as the example of Google's open-sourced linear book scanner design when discussing book digitization.

quote.text: Google developed a system called the "cheese grater" and open-sourced the plans / design
